title: Open-Meteo historical archive, Silverton grid point, 10-12 July 2016-2025
claims: The same daily query was repeated for 10-12 July in each year from 2016 to 2025; the URL records the 2025 window as the representative request.
The returned grid cell is 37.7856 N, 107.7108 W at 2,838 m elevation, timezone America/Denver.
Across the 30 days, daily maximum temperature ranged from 18.3 to 26.4 C with a median of 22.1 C.
Daily minimum temperature ranged from 1.8 to 11.4 C with a median of 6.3 C.
11 of the 30 days had at least 1 mm of precipitation, 5 had at least 5 mm, and the maximum daily total was 14 mm.
These are gridded historical values, not on-course measurements.
